test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_histogram_quantile_ts (metric_name, tags, time_series) SELECT 'http_request_duration_seconds_bucket', map( 'instance', toString(intDiv(number, 20)), 'job', 'api', 'le', if(number % 20 = 19, '+Inf', toString(number % 20))), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(100 + step * 10, 3), toFloat64((step + 1) * (number % 20 + 1))), range(300)) FROM numbers_mt(400 * 20)
